## Appearance

Hester Gray is a small girl with dark hair that is easily ruffled by the wind. She is also noted for having soft eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P40](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0040)_

## Personality

Hester Gray is remembered as a sweet and very pretty individual. Though she is not particularly skilled at housekeeping, she possesses a natural knack with flowers.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

## History

Hester Gray was brought up in the country, but later worked in a [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) store that she hated. After her husband [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) was given a farm in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he built a house where the couple lived together for four years. Following her death, her forgotten garden in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) remained as a romantic woodland site, where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) later accepted [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's marriage proposal.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P2](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0002), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P4](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0004), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P5](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0005), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), +106 more_

## Relationships

### [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/hester-gray--jordan.md)

[Jordan](../character/jordan.md) was Hester Gray's husband, whom she married in [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) before the couple relocated to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their marriage formed the primary background of her romantic life story, which later became a memorable local tale recounted by [Diana Barry](../character/di.md). They lived together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) until Hester's passing, leaving behind a secluded garden that preserved her memory.

- Spouse of — married in Boston and moved to Avonlea  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054)</sub>
